name: Plant Biology PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 application dates confirmed. The admission model is not explicitly established on the opened pages.

english.note: Old-scale sections: reading/listening/speaking 19, writing 22. New-scale: reading/speaking 4, listening/writing 4.5. IELTS sections at least 6.0. Automatic waivers include qualifying completed U.S./English-speaking-country bachelor's and U.S.-campus AAU master's degrees; other waiver requests go through department.

documents: Official transcripts sent directly by institutions
International applicants: English proficiency and financial affidavit/proof of support
requirements.note: Contact prospective faculty about sponsorship before deadline. Typical preparation: bachelor's degree, one year biology and one year each chemistry, physics and mathematics. Graduate School offers McNair and targeted recruitment-event waivers; international eligibility not explicitly stated, confirm. FreeApp participation ends December 31, 2026. Fee amount not stated on opened program pages.

timeline.interviews: Plant Science Fellowship on-site visit February 4–7, 2027.
timeline.decisions: Admission/offer letters early March; acceptance due April 15 (2027 timeline).

funding.note: Department commits financial assistance to accepted students; minimum five years expected with satisfactory progress. Page warns limited programmatic funding for international students. Undated listed awards: UDF and Plant Science Fellowship $32,000; CNS $33,000. TA nine-month package $23,940; confirm current rates.
